en: The postcard shows a historical town square with a large equestrian statue prominently placed in the center. The square is bordered by multi-story buildings with ornate roofs, several with German signage. A tall street lamp stands next to the statue. The photo is monochrome and appears to be from the early 20th century. The text 'Oschatz. Altmarkt.' is printed in the upper left corner.
